title: Belesis
summary: Raleigh names Belesis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Belesis, a Chaldaean, told Arbaces that the Kingdome of Sardanapalus should fall into his hands, and Arbaces promised vnto Belosus the gouernment of Babylon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
